data.lvmd.yaml:
socket-name: /run/topolvm/lvmd.sock
device-classes: 
  - default: true
    name: ssd
    spare-gb: 1
    volume-group: e2e-w1
  - name: nvme-thin
    thin-pool:
      name: pool0
      overprovision-ratio: 5
    type: thin
    volume-group: e2e-w1

socket-name: /run/topolvm/lvmd.sock
device-classes: 
  - default: true
    name: ssd
    spare-gb: 1
    volume-group: e2e-w2
  - name: hdd
    spare-gb: 0
    volume-group: e2e-w2-hdd

socket-name: /run/topolvm/lvmd.sock
device-classes: 
  - default: true
    name: ssd
    spare-gb: 1
    volume-group: e2e-w3
